content:
Dungeons and Legends Yazz's brings a growing collection of creatures, bosses, structures, and other content inspired by Minecraft Dungeons and Minecraft Legends into Minecraft: Java Edition.

This is not intended to be a collection of direct copies. Mobs are redesigned with improved mechanics, custom animations, new attacks, and additional behaviors while preserving the identities that made them memorable in their original games.

Features

  • Reimagined mobs from Minecraft Dungeons and Minecraft Legends

  • Challenging bosses with unique attacks and mechanics

  • New structures and encounters to discover

  • Features designed to fit naturally into Minecraft's survival gameplay

Some creatures remain faithful to their original roles, while others receive completely expanded mechanics to make their encounters more interesting and enjoyable.

Development

Because of the size of the project, planned content and release schedules may occasionally change. Check the Files and Changelog sections for the latest supported versions and available content.

This Mod Has No Dependencies

Modpacks

You are welcome to include Yazz's Dungeons and Legends in modpacks.
